messages.subject: summary() returning blank R-square
parts:

This happens even when I run the same code (same model, etc.) that has worked fine in the past for returning the r-square--I can't figure out what I'm doing wrong.

This is happening when I run either the development version or the CRAN version of lavaan.

Does anyone have any advice for getting my r-square values?

Thanks very much,
Jesse

messages.author: af82fa98896529e2
messages.subject: Re: summary() returning blank R-square
parts:
It could be a bug. I check it and it does not show up too. Here is the full code I ran.

library(lavaan)
c <- rnorm(100, 0, 1)
a <- 0.5*x + rnorm(100, 0, sqrt(0.75))
d <- rnorm(100, 0, 1)
b <- 0.2*a + 0.3*c + 0.4*d + rnorm(100, 0, 1)
hops <- data.frame(a, b, c, d)

mod1 <- '
a~c
b~a+c+d
'
mod.fit1 <- sem(mod1, data=hops)

summary(mod.fit1, rsquare = TRUE)
inspect(mod.fit1, "r2")
